Welcome.lead: Muslim Berislam reads where the sun is today, then shows you the one thing to do right now — with its evidence, without a list that piles up.
Welcome.featTitle: Small instruments for a steady day.
Welcome.featLead: Everything on screen has one job: tell you what's next, then give you room.
Welcome.f1Body: The five prayers sit on the sun's path at the real times for your city (KEMENAG method). The bright dot is now; the countdown runs to the next prayer.
Welcome.demo1Sum: Keep the first takbir for 40 days and two freedoms are written: from the Fire and from hypocrisy. (HR. Tirmidzi no. 241)
Welcome.f4Quote: “The deeds most loved by Allah are the most regular ones, even if small.”
Welcome.f5Body: Two choices with the same size and motion. No red, no broken streaks — missed items can be marked later.
Welcome.howTitle: A few seconds, a few times a day.
Welcome.step1Body: After Fajr, between work, before sleep. The orbit shows where your day is now.
Welcome.step2Body: One tap. The next card slides in calmly; anything missed waits in today's list.
Welcome.step3Body: A sentence or two on Profile. Your worship history builds itself, with no score.
Welcome.themeTitle: Night or day sky, Ikhwan or Akhwat.
Welcome.themeLead: Mint and sky blue for Ikhwan, orchid and apricot for Akhwat. Pick one — this whole page changes with it.
Welcome.a1: No. You start as a guest and every feature works. Add an email and password on Profile any time — all your guest data is kept.
Welcome.q2: Where do prayer times come from?
Welcome.a2: From the Aladhan service using the KEMENAG method, based on the city and country in your profile. If the service can't be reached, the app uses estimated times.
Welcome.a3: Open "All of today's tasks" and mark it any time. No streak breaks and no reminders that blame you.
Welcome.q4: Can the animation be turned off?
Welcome.a4: Yes. The app follows your device's "reduce motion" setting: glows, orbits and transitions stop, the content stays the same.
Welcome.a5: Bahasa Indonesia, English and Bahasa Melayu.
Welcome.ctaTitle: One small step, at the right time.
Welcome.ctaBody: No lists, no ads. Open, do, be at peace.
Welcome.ctaQuote: “For indeed, with hardship comes ease.” — QS. Al-Insyirah: 5
